item.title: Deal with MiniZinc files
item.description:
You can find here the instructions to parse and solve MiniZinc files with Choco-solver. The first thing to understand is that MiniZinc is a high-level constraint modeling language and choco-solver is not able to parse MiniZinc files directly. Actually, MiniZinc files must be converted into FlatZinc files before being parsed by Choco-solver.

There exists different ways to parse and solve MiniZinc files with Choco-solver. The recommended way is to use the MiniZinc IDE, which is a graphical user interface that allows to write, parse and solve MiniZinc files.

item.title: XCSP3 and DIMACS
item.description:
Dealing with XCSP3 and DIMACS formats is simpler than dealing with MiniZinc files. Actually, Choco-solver is able to parse and solve instances in these formats directly, without any conversion.

The command line to parse and solve XCSP3 files is the following:

java -cp /path/to/choco-X.Y.Z-light.jar org.chocosolver.parser.xcsp.ChocoXCSP [<options>] [<file>]

The command line to parse and solve DIMACS files is the following:

java -cp /path/to/choco-X.Y.Z-light.jar org.chocosolver.parser.dimacs.ChocoDIMACS [<options>] [<file>]

To have an up-to-date lists of options, you can run the command with the -h option.
